commitResults.messageTitle: Size the result area from its font so the deletion preview fits
commitResults.messageBody:
The result area was a fixed 160px. On Windows the platform font makes
the six-line deletion preview taller than that, so its last line needed
a scroll. ResultDisplay now measures seven lines of the area's own font
plus its padding and borders, and fixes the area at that height. It
measures again when the font or padding changes.

CompactFeedbackAcceptance again checks that the whole preview fits, also
with the font enlarged to stand in for taller platform lines, and that
the student list still shows a whole result card at the default and
minimum window sizes.

Refs #188

commitResults.messageTitle: Show the whole remark on result cards and in the profile
commitResults.messageBody:
A long remark was cut off with an ellipsis on a narrow result card, and
view EMAIL left the remark out of the profile, so the whole note could
not be read without widening the window. The card's remark label now
wraps, and the profile ends with a Remark line holding the complete
note when there is one. The stored text is unchanged.

RemarkReadabilityAcceptance saves a long remark through the command box
at 740x600 and 450x600, checks the card and profile show all of it, then
reloads the saved file and checks again, and that displayed indexes
still target the right student.

Refs #191

commitResults.messageTitle: Check the student list reaches the selected student at every size
commitResults.messageBody:
On physical Windows the panel check threw NoSuchElementException at
450x600: the selected card was scrolled partly above the list, so no
name was fully in view. The tallest sample card also cannot fit whole
there, so the claim that it does was wrong.

The check now requires, at every size, that the selected student's card
is in the list and that the list can show its whole name row, so the
rest is reached by scrolling. Only the default size must show the
tallest card whole. The DG states this and records the Windows result.

Refs #188

commitResults.messageTitle: Say the panel check measures room, not the selected card's position
commitResults.messageBody:
On Windows the check passes at 450x600 while the selected student's
heading starts partly above the list. The check only proves the list is
tall enough for the name row once scrolled to it, so name and describe
it that way, and record the Windows list heights in the DG. The clipped
position also happens on master and is not caused by the taller result
area.

Refs #188
